free_tier.stated: RUB 263 per day for the calculator's base configuration: 8 vCPU AMD EPYC up to 3.4 GHz, 16 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe, 64 TB traffic, plus RUB 7 for one IPv4. Billing switches between day and month; the page defaulted to day and the month figure was not read. Component rates on the same configurator are RUB 10 per core, RUB 8 per GB of RAM and RUB 0.55 per GB of disk per day. The vps.today index row is a much smaller machine at RUB 150: 1 core at 3 GHz, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, 1 TB traffic, 1 Gbit/s, Moscow.

egress.terms: 64 TB included on the base tariff, 1 Gbit/s port; the index row at RUB 150 states 1 TB

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: own control panel, ISO mount, snapshots not stated; no public API documented on the page read
chaining: The only plan on this page that reaches 8 cores and 16 GB is also the only one that states 64 TB, and it is billed per day, so it suits a short burst of indexing rather than an always-on archive node

limits.value: 64 TB of traffic is included with the base tariff, so the measured wall on the vendor page is the byte allowance and then the 1 Gbit/s port; the index row at RUB 150 carries 1 TB instead, so the allowance moves with the configuration rather than sitting at one number.
